en: But before I do that, I want to introduce you all to a few people.

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that OK?

en: Yes or yes?

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that OK?

en: Yes?

en: All right.

en: OK. All right.

en: This is my team.

en: I've been at Oracle a really long time, 20 years.

en: Funny story.

en: So don't do the math and don't start adding in your head.

speaker: Unknown
en: So yeah, I'm an engineer, but I'm kind of a developer poser too.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I've got another group who does QA.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I have another group who does my front end development.
zh: 然后我还有另一个团队做我的前端开发。

speaker: Unknown
en: With AI, here's what I found out as a leader.
zh: 关于 AI，作为一名领导者，这是我发现的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because in the token maxing era of 2025, because you know we're not token maxing anymore, right?
zh: 因为在 2025 年的 token maxing 时代——因为你们知道我们现在已经不做 token maxing 了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We are responsible AI-ing now.

speaker: Unknown
en: But in the token maxing era, the thing that I found out was while AI was making the individuals on my team faster, there was another problem it was creating.
zh: 但在那个 token maxing 时代，我发现的事情是，当 AI 让我团队里的个人变得更快的同时，它也造成了另一个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't making my team more productive.
zh: 它并没有让我的团队更有生产力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason was when one team from the Netherlands checked in code at my 4 a.m. in the morning, because I've got half of my team that's in EMEA, and I have half of my team that are here in the United States.
zh: 原因是，当来自荷兰的一个团队在我凌晨 4 点提交代码时——因为我有一半团队在 EMEA，另一半团队在美国这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: They checked in the code, but they didn't check in their context from Codex.
zh: 他们提交了代码，但没有提交他们来自 Codex 的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use Codex at Oracle.
zh: 我们在 Oracle 使用 Codex。

speaker: Unknown
en: So then when the US team woke up, they got the code, but no information about the context.
zh: 于是当美国团队醒来时，他们拿到了代码，却没有任何关于上下文的信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we used AI to solve a problem that AI created.
zh: 所以我们用 AI 解决了一个 AI 自己制造的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And here's what we did.
zh: 以下是我们做了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, well, let me talk about this first.
zh: 哦，好，让我先谈谈这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: So some of the issues, the context, like I said, wasn't shared.
zh: 所以有一些问题，就像我说的，上下文没有被共享。

speaker: Unknown
en: GitHub wasn't tracking that.
zh: GitHub 没有追踪那些。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had repositories that were diverging, and I was asking the managers who work for me, what's happening to your teams?
zh: 我当时有一些仓库出现了分叉，我在问我手下的经理们，你们的团队到底发生了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Why are we not going faster?
zh: 为什么我们没能更快？

speaker: Unknown
en: We're spending all of this money on tokens, we're spending all this money on AI, yet something is missing because we're still spending time doing testing and validation.
zh: 我们在 token 上花了这么多钱，在 AI 上花了这么多钱，但还是有缺失的东西，因为我们仍然要花时间做测试和验证。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our net-net wasn't really working for us.
zh: 所以我们的净结果对我们来说并不真正有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because Git records the code and not human intent.
zh: 因为 Git 记录的是代码，而不是人类意图。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's a problem.
zh: 所以这是个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even though code creation was no longer our problem, we still had a bottleneck.
zh: 即便代码创建已经不再是我们的问题，我们仍然有一个瓶颈。

speaker: Unknown
en: We needed a collaboration layer.
zh: 我们需要一个协作层。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I do have members of my team in the audience.
zh: 现在，我的团队确实有成员在现场。

speaker: Unknown
en: So don't judge me, and you know who you are.
zh: 所以别评判我，你们知道自己是谁。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not saying that you all didn't collaborate, but now we've got a new team member, and that new team member is AI.
zh: 我不是说你们都没有协作，但现在我们有了一个新的团队成员，这个新团队成员就是 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we needed to figure out how to track our progress and our next steps, how to rationalize decisions that the agent was making.
zh: 所以我们需要弄清楚如何追踪我们的进展和下一步，如何对智能体做出的决策进行理顺。

speaker: Unknown
en: We needed to figure out how to resolve questions and conflicts.
zh: 我们需要弄清楚如何解决问题和冲突。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hold my problem.
zh: 帮我拿着这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Will you all hold my problem for me?
zh: 大家能帮我拿着这个问题吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Right here, we're gonna just tuck that in a little box.
zh: 就放在这里，我们把它塞进一个小盒子里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me define what a enterprise agent actually is.
zh: 让我来定义一下企业智能体到底是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now most people think that an enterprise agent is the model and workflow.
zh: 大多数人认为企业智能体就是模型和工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many people agree with me?
zh: 有多少人同意我的看法？

speaker: Unknown
en: Man, this is a tough crowd.
zh: 天哪，这帮观众真难带。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, one person.
zh: 好吧，一个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, the rest of you think it's a little bit more?
zh: 好吧，你们其他人觉得还不止这些？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, let's see what.
zh: 好的，让我们看看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could it be that a real enterprise agent has tools?
zh: 会不会真正的企业智能体还有工具？

speaker: Unknown
en: Tools are how it does things.
zh: 工具是它做事的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Context.
zh: 上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: The context, that's a context window.
zh: 上下文，那是上下文窗口。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what's in the actual prompt.
zh: 那就是实际提示词里的内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: Memory, huh.
zh: 记忆，嗯。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're thinking, but wait, okay, memory, you just said that the model's kind of like the brain of the operation, hold tight, we're gonna talk a little bit more about memory.
zh: 如果你在想，等等，好吧，记忆，你刚才不是说模型有点像整个运作的大脑吗，稍安勿躁，我们会再多聊聊记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Retrieval, because you don't want to get everything back, so that's being able to retrieve the right information back.
zh: 检索，因为你不想把所有东西都取回来，所以要能够取回正确的信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I know that there are a lot of developers here and you all don't care about security.
zh: 然后我知道这里有很多开发者，你们都不在乎安全。

speaker: Unknown
en: I care about security because I work for the most secure database company.
zh: 我在乎安全，因为我为最安全的数据库公司工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I used to work for an agency that has no name.
zh: 而且我曾经为一个没有名字的机构工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But guardrails is also important.
zh: 但护栏也很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the harness.
zh: 这就是马具。

speaker: Unknown
en: I speak in analogies, and I speak in stories, because if I tell you this and marvel, you know exactly what I'm talking about.
zh: 我用类比说话，用故事说话，因为如果我这样跟你讲，你立刻就明白我在说什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the agent, think of it as the model, little brain floating in a glass jar, plus this harness.
zh: 所以这个智能体，把它想象成模型——漂浮在玻璃罐里的小大脑——再加上这个马具。

speaker: Unknown
en: This harness is the body.
zh: 这个马具就是身体。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's how the agent can actually do things and get things done.
zh: 所以它就是智能体真正能做事、把事情办成的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: That memory, that's the part of the central nervous system, and you remember the central nervous system connects the brain to the rest of the body, legs, arms.
zh: 那个记忆，那是中枢神经系统的一部分，你记得中枢神经系统把大脑和身体的其他部分连接起来，腿、手臂。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the part of the central nervous system that carries context.
zh: 那是中枢神经系统中承载上下文的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you remember my problem with Git?
zh: 所以你记得我说的 Git 问题吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: What I needed was memory.
zh: 我需要的就是记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so there are a number of memory types.
zh: 好的，记忆有若干种类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: I chose five, the five most common ones that people talk about, and these are the ones that I want you to remember.
zh: 我选了五种，人们最常谈论的五种，这些是我要你们记住的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one is short-term memory.
zh: 第一种是短期记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the session, right?
zh: 那就是会话，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so if you're storing memory of an AI process, that is, the short-term memory is if you're with chat, Claude Code, right, Codex, pick your poison.
zh: 所以如果你在存储 AI 过程的记忆，也就是说，短期记忆就是当你在用 chat、Claude Code，对吧，Codex，随便你选哪个。

speaker: Unknown
en: The long-term memory is what persists across sessions.
zh: 长期记忆是跨会话持续存在的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Episodic memory, hmm, what happened the last time I interacted with fill-in-the-blank?
zh: 情景记忆，嗯，我上次和某某互动时发生了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's your episodic memory.
zh: 那就是你的情景记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Procedural memory, tools, steps that were taken.
zh: 程序性记忆，工具、所采取的步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then finally, semantic memory.
zh: 最后是语义记忆。

speaker: Unknown
en: And semantic memory, because we're talking enterprise agents.
zh: 而语义记忆，因为我们说的是企业智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're not talking the agent that I built, Sasha Fierce, because remember I told you guys that I'm a dancer, so of course my chief of staff is gonna be called Sasha Fierce because that was Beyonce.
zh: 我们不是在说我构建的那个叫 Sasha Fierce 的智能体，因为记得我告诉过你们我是跳舞的，所以当然我的参谋长要叫 Sasha Fierce，因为那是 Beyonce。

speaker: Unknown
en: Any Beyonce fans?
zh: 有 Beyonce 的粉丝吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: All right, we gotta focus.
zh: 好了，我们得专注了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so these are the memory types.
zh: 好，这些就是记忆类型。

en: Now, when you're defining this real enterprise agent in this memory, there's something you need to consider, where to store it.
zh: 现在，当你在定义这个真正的企业智能体和它的记忆时，有一个你需要考虑的事情，就是存到哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm gonna tell you guys a story.
zh: 所以我要给你们讲一个故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when I tell you the story, you have to promise me that you're not gonna judge me.
zh: 但我讲这个故事的时候，你们得保证不会评判我。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you promise?
zh: 你们保证吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you promise?
zh: 你们保证吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: You're not recording me right because this doesn't paint me in a good light.
zh: 你们没在录我吧，因为这段可不能让我形象好看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, all right, the world of data was one simple.
zh: 好的，好吧，数据的世界曾经很简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been at Oracle a long time, but I came from a customer.
zh: 我在 Oracle 待了很久，但我是从客户那边过来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That customer's name was Southern Company.
zh: 那个客户叫 Southern Company。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a power company.
zh: 那是一家电力公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm based out of Atlanta.
zh: 我驻扎在亚特兰大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was hired at Southern Company because I was a rock star performance tuner.
zh: 我被 Southern Company 雇用是因为我是个性能调优的摇滚明星。

speaker: Unknown
en: You had a SQL query.
zh: 你有一条 SQL 查询。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, I'm dating myself, but whatever.
zh: 我是说，我这是暴露年龄了，但无所谓。

speaker: Unknown
en: You had a SQL query.
zh: 你有一条 SQL 查询。

speaker: Unknown
en: I knew all of the init.ora parameters, even the ones when you called support and they said, don't remember these, don't write them down.
zh: 我知道所有的 init.ora 参数，甚至包括那些你打给支持、他们说“别记住这些，别写下来”的参数。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wrote them down in my little notebook.
zh: 我把它们写在了我的小本本上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I could tune a query within one inch of its life.
zh: 我能把一条查询调优到极致。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then one of you came to my desk because, I mean, the world was rows and columns.
zh: 后来你们中的一个人来到我的桌前，因为，我是说，那时候的世界就是行和列。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a great time back in my Al Bundy days.
zh: 那是我 Al Bundy 岁月里的美好时光。

speaker: Unknown
en: And said, hey, I need to store data unstructured.
zh: 然后他说，嘿，我需要存储非结构化数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?
zh: 为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Why do you do that?
zh: 你为什么要那样做？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so me being Kay, the diligent DBA, I was like, let me figure it out and get back to you.
zh: 于是我，Kay，这个尽职的 DBA，就说，让我研究一下再回复你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did I get back to him?
zh: 我回复他了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't get back to him.
zh: 我没回复他。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, the thing you have to know about Southern Company was for every database system that a DBA managed, I had to attend two meetings.
zh: 现在，你们必须知道 Southern Company 的一点是，对于 DBA 管理的每一个数据库系统，我得参加两个会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, when I hear Sarbanes-Oxley, I still throw up a little bit in the back of my throat.
zh: 今天，当我听到 Sarbanes-Oxley，我还是会稍微有点想吐。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I had to attend a security meeting and a patching meeting every week, never fail.
zh: 所以我每周都得参加一个安全会议和一个补丁会议，从不缺席。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, because this developer installed a database that was specialized for unstructured.
zh: 现在，因为这个开发者装了一个专门针对非结构化的数据库。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, there are really smart people in the room.
zh: 好的，这屋里有很聪明的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many meetings am I going to now?
zh: 我现在要参加几个会议？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, I'm a little annoyed, but I'm like, okay, we can do this.
zh: 好吧，我有点烦，但我想，好吧，我们能搞定。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then they said, okay, since you're such a good tuner, I need you to figure out this relationship.
zh: 然后他们说，好，既然你调优这么厉害，我需要你搞清楚这个关联关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, the way that Southern Company worked, there was this people could die application, and it was like a Nokia phone that people who were climbing the towers, right?
zh: 当时 Southern Company 的运作方式是，有一个“人会死”的应用程序，就像一个诺基亚手机，给那些爬塔的人用，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So you guys have been in a storm and the power goes out, right?
zh: 你们都经历过暴风雨然后停电，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you're pretty sure that within maybe an hour or two the power will go on.
zh: 然后你很确定大概一两个小时后电就会来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, that system that would tell the people who are climbing those trees and risking their lives to turn the power back on sometimes would have false positives or false negatives.
zh: 嗯，那个系统是告诉那些爬树、冒着生命危险去恢复供电的人的，但它有时会出现假阳性或假阴性。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they wanted to look at all of the other polls in the area
zh: 所以他们想查看该区域所有其他的电线杆

speaker: Unknown
en: To try to get away from the false positive or the false negative.
zh: 试图摆脱假阳性或假阴性的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I did that in a SQL query and it was amazing.
zh: 于是我在一个 SQL 查询里做到了这个,效果惊人。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a five nested union all statement.
zh: 那是一条五层嵌套的 union all 语句。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was some of my best work.
zh: 那是我的一些最佳作品之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now it might have taken like 20 minutes to work but it was like a predecessor to graph.
zh: 它可能花了大概 20 分钟才跑完,但它就像是图数据库的前身。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, they installed Neo4j.
zh: 是啊,他们安装了 Neo4j。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now how many meetings am I going to?
zh: 那么现在我要开多少个会?

speaker: Unknown
en: Six.
zh: 六个。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a problem.
zh: 这是个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I, oh, let me, I got ahead of myself.
zh: 所以我,哦,让我,我讲超前了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you know what I did?
zh: 你们知道我做了什么吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I quit.
zh: 我辞职了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I left and I came to Oracle because I was like, this is a problem and maybe I can go to Oracle to help solve it.
zh: 我离开了,来到了 Oracle,因为我想,这是个问题,也许我可以去 Oracle 帮忙解决它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So then Joe Mundy called me and he said, hey, we are installing Redis.
zh: 然后 Joe Mundy 打电话给我,他说,嘿,我们要安装 Redis 了。
